mr_title: Prevented urlize creating broken links given a markdown link input.

expected_issues.title: urlize() no longer links multi-label domain names
expected_issues.description:
The new simple_url_2_re only accepts a single hostname label before the TLD, so urlize() stops linking multi-label domains such as 'docs.djangoproject.com' or 'mail.example.org'.

DomainNameValidator.hostname_re matches one DNS label. The previous pattern `\w[^@]+` accepted any dotted name ending with a known TLD. After this change `urlize('see docs.example.com')` no longer produces a link, a behaviour regression beyond the markdown case being fixed; the domain part (DomainNameValidator.domain_re) must be included between hostname and TLD.
